name: A solo kill by the Greater Imp alone gives no experience; the knight hitting it first does
contract: SoloKill.RequirePlayerHit (default 1): a player who is not in a group gets loot and experience from a creature only if they hit it themselves with an attack or a harmful spell, so pets, guardians and other summons left to fight on their own (AFK farming) earn nothing. Summon: Greater Imp 520661 is SPELL_EFFECT_SUMMON_PET for creature 510100, taught by the level-10 Greater Imp passive 92101, so the imp is a real Pet owned by the knight. Expected: when the imp alone kills a level-10 Harvest Golem and the knight never swings, the knight's XP does not change. When the knight lands one melee swing on a second golem and the imp finishes it, the knight's XP rises while the knight stays level 10. The golems' 300 health exceeds their template health, so the imp's damage clears the player damage requirement whichever health it was sized from.
